MEATBALLS WITH SPÄTZLE
1 pound ground beef
1/4 cup milk
1 egg, beaten
1/4 cup dry bread crumbs
1 tablespoon chopped parsley
1/4 teaspoon poultry seasoning
Salt and pepper to taste
2 tablespoons oil
1 3-ounce can mushrooms,
drained
1 can beef broth
1/2 cup chopped onion
1 cup sour cream
1 tablespoon flour
1/2 teaspoon caraway seed
2 cups flour
1 teaspoon salt
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup milk

Combine 2 cups flour with remaining ingredients in bowl; beat until mixture comes away from side of bowl. Place in colander. Press dough through colander with spoon into saucepan of boiling salted water. Cook for 5 minutes, stirring frequently; drain. Place in serving bowl. Spoon meatballs and sauce over top. Yield: 6 servings.

31/2 cups shredded cabbage
2 tablespoons butter
1 pound ground beef
Salt and pepper to taste
1 package dry yeast
2 teaspoons sugar
1/4 cup warm water
3/4 cup milk, scalded, cooled
1/2 teaspoon shortening
2 cups flour
